problem_statement: V2G proved deterministic and market-blind but failed held-out predictive and signed key-number gates. V2H changes the football generative mechanism before any V2H result is observed; it does not retune V2G against held-out key-number errors.

architecture.score_construction: Generate PIT-safe team possession scoring sequences from training-only football event state, convert explicit scoring outcomes to integer points, then construct a joint home/away score distribution before any sportsbook threshold or price is applied.
architecture.dependence_policy: Allow a preregistered training-only shared latent game pace/opportunity state to induce home-away scoring opportunity dependence. The latent state may be estimated only from prior training seasons and may not consume market lines, closing prices, held-out outcomes, signed key-number targets, or prospective results.
architecture.key_number_policy: No explicit +/-3 or +/-7 probability target, correction factor, bonus mass, calibration target, or key-frequency loss is permitted. Key-number mass must emerge from football-native scoring sequences.

forbidden_inputs: historical signed key-number target frequencies as a fitting or selection objective
outer-fold outcomes during fitting or hyperparameter selection
prospective outcomes for candidate selection or tuning
V2G held-out per-key residuals as a numerical tuning target

fit_and_selection.selection_objective: Frozen predictive probability loss only; no key-number objective
